answer: Require each identity to escrow a 540-unit bond and serve a twenty-eight epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for twelve rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 540 units per alias and replays twenty-eight rounds, while an island of linked traces exposes the ring, cedar-sealed history prevents reuse, and falcon markers track provenance.
